title: aisha-patel-sre-oncall-scratchpad-2026-03-31
content:
SRE on-call scratchpad - 2026-03-31
Owner: Aisha Patel (eng-sre)

Overview
- Night shift handoff from Noah at 22:00 UTC. Quiet until 02:14 UTC when paging started for svc-gen-1 high tail-latency.
- Primary incidents tonight:
  1) INC-2026-031-7: svc-gen-1 high p95/p99 latency spikes, correlated with burst of long-context requests (seq_len ~ 8k).
  2) short noise: k8s node eviction (node-gpu-12) flapped 03:28 UTC, recovered via auto-replace. No customer impact after autoscaler kicked in.

Timeline (quick)
- 02:14 UTC: Pager -> Alert: svc-gen-1 p99 > 2.5s for 3+ minutes.
  * Slack: #oncall -> started checking dashboards.
  * PgSQL: quick check of request rates, saw 3x baseline for long-context routes (/chat/long).
- 02:20 UTC: Scaled up pool (manual) + triggered fallback routing to gen-2-small (lower-cost but compatible) via routing policy.
- 02:23 UTC: Latency improved to p99 ~1.1s after routing; still elevated p95 for a subset of requests.
- 02:40 UTC: Identified KV-cache miss storm -> clients sending slightly different prompt prefixes (session metadata) preventing prefix caching.
- 03:05 UTC: Rolled a hotfix in routing to treat small prefix differences as same cache key for known clients (temporary).
  * Patch applied to routing layer: treat-session-meta-as-opaque flag for specific client tags.
- 03:28 UTC: node-gpu-12 eviction triggered; autoscaler replaced node, pods rescheduled. Observed transient increase in error rate but fallback routing prevented customer impact.
- 04:15 UTC: Incident declared resolved for paging purposes; entry into follow-up/retro.

Immediate actions taken
- Manual scale + routing override (02:20 - 02:40) to offload to gen-2-small for compatible flows.
- Temporary routing tweak to broaden prefix cache keys for high-frequency clients.
- Opened INC ticket and attached traces & flamegraphs (see linked_artifacts).

Diagnostics performed / notes
- Traces: heavy tail due to repeated cache misses on long-context requests (KV cache not being reused because of per-request metadata in prefix).
- Metrics: token throughput steady, request rate spike was for long-seq routes only (no change in short-seq).
- Infra: single node eviction traced to underlying host OOM (kernel oom_killer) during kernel patch rollout on that worker pool. Node had been scheduled for maintenance; need to confirm drain behavior.

Follow-ups / TODOs (priority-ordered)
1) Runbook updates: "Handling prefix-cache miss storms" - add decision tree + playbook steps. Owner: @Lena Garcia. Due: 2026-04-07.
   - Include checklist to identify client-side prefix noise (regex to normalize session metadata).
   - Add recommended routing override commands and rollback steps.
2) Incident postmortem (INC-2026-031-7): draft with timeline, root cause (client metadata -> cache miss amplification + maintenance-induced node churn), mitigation, and long-term fix. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-04-03.
3) Long-term fix: routing-layer canonicalization of prompt prefixes at inference edge (opt-in per client). Product/solutions input required (privacy implications). Owner: eng-serving-runtime. RFC due 2026-04-15.
4) K8s node maintenance docs: check autoscaler drain config and scheduled maintenance behavior for GPU pools; ensure cordon+drain before kernel patch. Owner: infra-team (cc: @Sam Rodriguez). Due: 2026-04-10.
5) Add metrics alert: detect "cache miss rate" for prefix cache (threshold > 30% sustained) and fire separate alert to avoid chasing latency SLO only. Owner: observability. Due: 2026-04-05.
6) Backfill: send customer-facing note to affected tenants (if any) with summary + mitigation. Owner: customer-success. Due: 2026-04-02.

Runbook TODOs (my personal action items)
- [ ] Draft initial postmortem (start outline tonight).
- [x] Attach traces to INC ticket (done 04:30 UTC).
- [ ] Add log snippets and sample trace IDs to the ticket.
- [ ] Schedule 30-min follow-up with infra + runtime (prefer 2026-04-01 16:00 PT).
- [ ] Create PR for routing tweak rollback plan (target: staged rollback next week).

Notes for oncall handoff
- Current state: routing override removed; prefix-canonicalization flag is off by default except for the specific client tokens we enabled. System stable.
- Watchlist for next 24h: svc-gen-1 p95/p99, prefix-cache hit-rate, node eviction rate in gpu-prod pool.
- Contacts: Sam Rodriguez (infra), Lena Garcia (runtime), Priya Shah (observability).

Questions / unresolved
- Which clients were sending the noisy prefixes? We have list of client IDs in traces but need product contact to confirm privacy-safe normalization.
- Is there any reason autoscaler didn't cordon node-gpu-12 before kernel patch? Check infra maintenance pipeline.

Useful links / artifacts
- INC ticket: INC-2026-031-7
- JIRA: JIRA-4567 (postmortem ticket)
- PR with temp routing tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
- Traces: trace-ids attached to INC ticket (see linked artifacts).

Personal notes / scratch ideas
- Could we add a small client-side SDK helper that normalizes session prefix fields (opt-in) to reduce noise? Ship as optional lib in next SDK release.
- Consider a dynamic cache-key hashing layer that can ignore ephemeral metadata fields based on allowlist. Might be heavier but more robust.

Quick checklist for tomorrow (handoff)
- Confirm postmortem draft in progress and assign reviewers.
- Check that observability alert for cache-miss-rate is created.
- Follow up with infra on maintenance/eviction root cause.

-- Aisha
(added notes on 2026-03-31 05:10 UTC; updated 2026-04-01 09:05 UTC)
